title: Music City Getaway, 10 min to Downtown and Opry
description:
This beautiful Nashville home is tucked away 9 min from the Grand Ole Opry and 4 miles to Broadway ! Its an open concept 2500- sq feet 3 bedroom 2 baths perfect for families or couples. 
You can enjoy the beautiful backyard with cocktails or morning coffee or if you are the cook in your group ..., our kitchen is set up to inspire your inner Bobby Flay ...or Julia Child ..We can't wait to see Y'all in Nashville !

The space
About the Space
– 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (sleeps 8)
– Bedroom 1: King bed
– Bedroom 2: Queen bed
– Bedroom 3: Queen bed
– Living room: Sofa bed
– Fresh bedding + towels provided
– Quality bath essentials + hair dryer
– Fully stocked kitchen w/ GE appliances
– Drip coffee maker + toaster + kettle
– Dedicated workspace in shared area
– 65” HDTV + central A/C + ceiling fans
– In-unit washer + dryer
– Private backyard w/ patio + seating
– Free parking on driveway
– Self check-in via keypad

Other things to note
Smoking of anything is not aloud inside the home. (including vapes)
We allow pets with approval. We do have a size and weight limit.
The home has neighbors close by, so parties are not allowed.
Quiet hours are 11:00pm to 8:00am
